noscript.content_model_reason: The index's Children column says only "varies", which has no mechanical mapping. Union of both cases: transparent (body) plus link/meta/style (head).

template.content_model_reason: The index's "empty" describes the DOM children, not what may be written between <template> and </template>; using it would forbid every template's contents.

@global/accesskey.reason: Kept as a single key (as in the legacy document) for API ergonomics; the spec allows a space-separated list of single code points.

@global/aria.reason: aria-* attributes (ARIA in HTML) are not in browser-compat-data's HTML globals; modelled as a prefix like data-*.

@global/exportparts.reason: CSS Shadow Parts: comma-separated list of part[:alias] mappings. Neither the index nor the IDL lists it; no kind models a comma-separated list, so String is the deliberate type.

@global/part.reason: CSS Shadow Parts: space-separated part names.

@global/role.reason: ARIA role attribute (wai-aria IDL reflects it) is not in browser-compat-data's HTML globals.

a/download.reason: Bare attribute (download) or a suggested file name: generated as an Enum with only the empty value plus custom values. The legacy document typed it as Bool, which cannot express a file name.

a/referrerpolicy.reason: Referrer Policy tokens. The WHATWG index only says "Referrer policy", so this stays a judgment call; the legacy document typed it as String.

area/download.reason: Bare attribute (download) or a suggested file name: generated as an Enum with only the empty value plus custom values. The legacy document typed it as Bool, which cannot express a file name.

area/referrerpolicy.reason: Referrer Policy tokens. The WHATWG index only says "Referrer policy", so this stays a judgment call; the legacy document typed it as String.

audio/controlslist.reason: Set of tokens (nodownload, nofullscreen, noremoteplayback) from a WICG proposal that browser-compat-data lists as standard-track.

audio/disableremoteplayback.reason: Boolean attribute from the Remote Playback API (W3C).

button/command.reason: Built-in commands plus custom commands ("--name"), which the WHATWG index cannot express as a closed list.

iframe/referrerpolicy.reason: Referrer Policy tokens. The WHATWG index only says "Referrer policy", so this stays a judgment call; the legacy document typed it as String.

img/referrerpolicy.reason: Referrer Policy tokens. The WHATWG index only says "Referrer policy", so this stays a judgment call; the legacy document typed it as String.

input/capture.reason: HTML Media Capture (W3C) facing mode; not in the HTML standard.

input/webkitdirectory.reason: Boolean attribute from the File and Directory Entries API; browser-compat-data lists it as standard-track.

link/referrerpolicy.reason: Referrer Policy tokens. The WHATWG index only says "Referrer policy", so this stays a judgment call; the legacy document typed it as String.

ol/type.reason: Keywords 1, a, A, i, I differ only in case, so an Enum would generate colliding Go identifiers (OlTypeA twice); kept as Char like the legacy document.

script/referrerpolicy.reason: Referrer Policy tokens. The WHATWG index only says "Referrer policy", so this stays a judgment call; the legacy document typed it as String.

video/controlslist.reason: Set of tokens (nodownload, nofullscreen, noremoteplayback) from a WICG proposal that browser-compat-data lists as standard-track.

video/disableremoteplayback.reason: Boolean attribute from the Remote Playback API (W3C).
